contents.analysis: Task-contract audits, dependency metadata, repository metadata, license inventory, and static task classifications.
contents.assets: DepBench logo, icon, raster export, and responsive light/dark benchmark flow diagrams.
contents.custom_agents: Harbor agent adapters used by the provided Harbor config templates.
contents.governance: License, contribution, security, conduct, support, third-party notice, and open-source release checklist files in the repository root.
contents.packaging: pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, and setup.py define the installable release helpers and custom agent package.
contents.paper_review: Separate historical paper-review artifact: 203 tasks, 2030 matching trajectories, outcomes, verifier logs, and provenance under paper_review/. Not results for the 201-task main release.
